sloka: स तैः पञ्चभिराविद्धः शरैः शिरसि वानरः ।उत्पपात नदन् व्योम्नि दिशो दश विनादयन् ।। ५.४६.२१।।।।
transliteration: sa taiḥ pañcabhirāviddhaḥ śaraiḥ śirasi vānaraḥ ।utpapāta nadan vyomni diśo daśa vinādayan ।। 5.46.21।।।।

translations.english: With five arrows pierced in the head of the vanara, Hanuman leaped into the sky with terrible roar, which resounded in all the ten directions.
